notes: 34 units over 34 source ids and all 39 target ids; no id is duplicated or invented.

s029 *even unto* is the disputable unit. Reading it as one compound rendering of עַד headed on *unto* (rules 30, 24) is defensible since no waw or other morpheme stands in the temporal phrase to license *even*; the competing `added` reading under rules 30 and 42 is named in the unit note as rule 8 requires.

The two articles of עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה are rightly both unrepresented: the ASV writes a single determiner *this*, and the demonstrative s034 licenses it directly, so rule 41's transfer of a determiner to the article does not apply (that clause is limited to cases where no other morpheme licenses the word), and rule 29's last sentence covers the rest.

s016 is an attributive article rendered by the relative *that* (rule 41), with the copula and adjective staying on s017 under rule 20. s012 takes the supplied *the* because no article morpheme stands anywhere in בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל (rule 29).
